description: Staging platform decisions (AUT-102 to AUT-111), planned by infra/terraform/envs/staging-core. Changed only through a reviewed pull request. An entry whose status is PROPOSED has not been decided by the owner: plans run with the proposed value, and stack.sh apply refuses while any PROPOSED entry remains. Secrets and personal addresses are never stored here.

kms.decision: Integrated workstream 2026-10-05: two customer-managed keys (data, audit) instead of three, for cost (cost report); yearly rotation; 30-day deletion window.

storage.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): accepted as proposed. Lifecycle values are reversible; Object Lock retention is not.

anchor_retention.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): D6 option B. The anchor retention is configurable in the application (VEDA_ANCHOR_RETENTION_DAYS, whole days; required in staging, at least 3650 in production) and staging uses 30 days: staging-core plans /veda/staging/config/VEDA_ANCHOR_RETENTION_DAYS from application_retention_days, and the S3 anchor store locks every object in COMPLIANCE mode until now plus that retention. infra/tests/run.sh refuses deploy.enabled true unless the application change, the mapping and the planned parameter are all in place. The bucket has Object Lock enabled with no default retention.

cloudtrail.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): accepted as proposed. One multi-region trail of management events, log-file validation, audit key, copy in CloudWatch Logs kept 30 days (the S3 copy follows storage.logs_cloudtrail_expire_days). veda-boundary denies every role cloudtrail:Put*Selectors and UpdateTrail, so the S3 data events on the anchor and evidence buckets (FC-01, RR-09 attribution) are added once by the owner session after the first apply (runbook).

ecr.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): accepted as proposed. One repository veda-api (the bootstrap deploy role pushes only there), immutable tags, basic scan on push, data key; keep the last 30 tagged images, expire untagged images after 7 days. Litestream and cloudflared keep coming from Docker Hub, pinned by digest (the deploy role cannot push other repositories).

ssm.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): D7 accepted; the rest accepted as proposed. D7 staging host names; the trusted proxy is the Compose network gateway 172.30.0.1 (Docker address pool 172.30.0.0/16, AUT-001 host design): the peer the API sees for every request published on 127.0.0.1:8000; Litestream keeps 7 days of WAL; session transcripts 90 days; sessions end after 20 idle minutes and 60 minutes in all. Secrets are seeded by the owner under /veda/staging/app (AUT-302). 2026-10-07 (owner, AUT-202 to AUT-204): public_site_credentials true, because the staging site is behind Cloudflare Access and its intake call must carry the Access cookie of the API host; the API refuses this setting in production. 2026-10-08 (owner, VEDA-SPACES-ESTIMATOR-STAGING-VALIDATION; ADR-012 decision log 20): estimator_enabled true for staging only, behind Cloudflare Access, for protected validation; the Warranty, Service & Customer Care Policy link comes from the WARRANTY_POLICY_URL variable of the staging-plan environment and the plan refuses an enabled estimator without it; the API refuses the estimator in production.

monitoring.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): accepted as proposed. Application and host logs kept 30 days; a fixed set of 7 log metric filters instead of EMF (cost); alarm thresholds below; alarms email the owner (BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL secret) and feed the drill queue.

compute.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): accepted as proposed. T4g.small (N2, decided) with burst credits capped (standard); 12 GB root and 20 GB data volumes (gp3, data key); 7 daily snapshots of the data volume; the AMI is the latest Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 at the first plan and is then pinned here (ami_id).

ses.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-05 (docs/implementation/staging/STAGING-PLATFORM-owner-decisions.md): accepted as proposed. Sender no-reply@staging.vedaspaces.com (a subdomain, so the apex records never change; DKIM CNAMEs published by AUT-202); sandbox, with the owner's address verified as recipient (more rehearsal recipients: O11); alarm when the bounce rate exceeds 5 %.

deploy.decision: 2026-10-06 (owner, deploy-enable phase): deploy.enabled true, so 12-deploy may run and the deployment alarms notify (review R4). Merged only after the D6 change, the CloudTrail data events and the eight AUT-302 secrets; applied (1 parameter added, 11 alarm actions on) immediately before the first 12-deploy. Public lead intake stays disabled: no tunnel, DNS or Turnstile widget (AUT-201 to AUT-204), and the test Turnstile secret (D8) is not for public use.
